stages.name: 개척의 나무집
stages.motif: A tiny sapling carved directly into a plain wooden door lintel; humble origin, no badge.
stages.architecture: A SMALL habitable one-story rough timber cabin on a low wooden wagon bed. Plain uneven brown plank roof, one warm window, patched plank door, short visible right-front empty deck. No stone house or second story. Preserve native first-castle source canvas and lower floor, but leave transparent space at top after removing the flag.
stages.accent: matte warm brown wood, dull iron, a tiny muted leaf-green accent

stages.name: 새싹 수비소
stages.motif: Small oak leaves and a root-shaped carved corner beam, actual wood carving rather than a glowing logo.
stages.architecture: Timber lower house and compact raised lookout, slightly taller than first. One supply alcove and a plain short balcony. Wooden dwelling on a quiet grey stone skirt.
stages.accent: warm brown wood, grey stone, muted green corner trim

stages.name: 태양 사자 초소
stages.motif: One chunky original lion-face stone relief on the upper front lintel, with a few simple sun-ray cuts.
stages.architecture: Two connected stepped timber-and-stone volumes, lower storage hatch, taller lookout room. Functional little side terrace, no pyramid temple or sprawling town.
stages.accent: grey stone, warm timber, restrained turquoise and old brass

stages.name: 닻의 변경 요새
stages.motif: A modest anchor-shaped iron brace built into one timber support; no pirate flag or heraldic shield.
stages.architecture: Broad low stone gatehouse, unequal upper timber watch rooms, recessed supply hoist. Same basic house-and-keep lineage, not a ship-shaped building.
stages.accent: warm grey stone, brown wood, muted charcoal and brass

stages.name: 불새 주조성
stages.motif: A simple phoenix-wing bas-relief flanking the forge opening, using large geometric feather shapes.
stages.architecture: Heavy lower foundry block, upper inhabited keep, one compact glowing forge window, one stout chimney and short worker balcony. Thick stable lower mass.
stages.accent: dark grey stone, charcoal iron, small ember-orange light

stages.name: 서리 나무 성채
stages.motif: A leafless carved tree around a small icy-blue upper window and two sparse frost notches on stone corners.
stages.architecture: Vertical compact three-level keep, ordinary warm-lit doors, a sheltered workshop balcony. Stone walls remain grey, not an entire ice sculpture or snow mountain.
stages.accent: grey stone, dark wood, low-saturation icy slate-blue

stages.name: 청동 사자 공방
stages.motif: Original small lion relief inside one broad bronze gear housing, attached to a useful workshop winch.
stages.architecture: Taller tiered stone-and-timber stronghold with one bronze foundry chimney, upper living room, one recessed cargo hatch. Clear large volumes, not an all-metal factory.
stages.accent: grey stone, warm wood, muted copper-bronze

stages.name: 참나무 권양성
stages.motif: Root-shaped timber braces merging into a large working rope-winch frame, one small oak-leaf carving.
stages.architecture: Tall three-tier mixed timber-and-stone fortress, warehouse base and compact upper living gallery, one short recessed stair. Machinery gives character without horizontal expansion.
stages.accent: grey stone, desaturated oak, restrained bronze

stages.name: 수정 사자 성채
stages.motif: A compact stone lion head above a recessed violet-crystal power window; one bold carving rather than tiny filigree.
stages.architecture: Tall inhabited central stronghold and shorter offset service tower connected inside the hull width. Small warehouse loading door, workshop balcony and power bay.
stages.accent: grey stone, dark wood, muted violet crystals, dull brass

stages.name: 청룡 병참성
stages.motif: One stylized original dragon-head corner beam above a small gate; broad simple scale shapes only.
stages.architecture: Four stepped fortified floors with warehouse base, short service stairs, one covered work balcony and compact command roof. Strong ordinary-door scale.
stages.accent: warm grey stone, brown wood, muted jade and aged bronze

stages.name: 까마귀 비전성
stages.motif: Two small angular raven-head stone projections on a single upper lintel, never a forest of spikes.
stages.architecture: Stepped stone keep with a dark recessed arcane service bay, side habitation balcony, upper slate-roof room. Solid dimensional walls and a few ordinary warm windows.
stages.accent: warm grey stone, dark slate, restricted low-saturation violet

stages.name: 고목 수호성
stages.motif: Thick carved wood root supports embracing one stone doorway, one small living branch along a balcony; keep most wall area plain.
stages.architecture: Large vertical fortified settlement with lower logistics room, forge/repair alcove, timber living gallery and deep inset machinery chamber. Neither a giant treehouse nor a hollow tower.
stages.accent: grey stone, aged brown oak, muted leaf green

stages.name: 조개 수로성
stages.motif: A large simple scallop-shaped stone lintel and a shallow spiral water-channel carving, no shiny decorative shell palace.
stages.architecture: Vertical fortress with a recessed cooling cistern, upper residential gallery and compact water-driven service hoist. Architecture stays grounded stone and timber.
stages.accent: grey stone, warm wood, quiet sea-green and pale sand

stages.name: 태양 관측성
stages.motif: An original simple sun-disk and lion-sideprofile stone relief integrated into the command level's large lintel.
stages.architecture: Tall four-mass fortress with compact observatory room, short maintenance stair, work balcony and broad low supply hatch. No huge decorative telescope or crown-shaped roof.
stages.accent: grey stone, dark slate-blue roof caps, small warm brass accents

stages.name: 뇌목 동력성
stages.motif: Branch-shaped metal power conduits resembling a sacred oak, with one simple lightning-split trunk carving.
stages.architecture: Vertical industrial fortress with a deep central charging bay, one maintenance bridge inside the recess, strong upper living/command volumes and low warehouse hatches.
stages.accent: grey stone, dark steel, muted blue and small pale-cyan glow

stages.name: 홍염 불새 대성채
stages.motif: One paired phoenix-wing shoulder relief supporting the central keep; only a few bold stone feather cuts.
stages.architecture: Extremely heavy three-part vertical siege citadel, dark internal power bay, compact side forge, tiny maintenance doors, short service terraces. Human activity is embedded in immense machinery.
stages.accent: dark warm-grey stone, charcoal armor, muted crimson and ember light

stages.name: 별사슴 천문요새
stages.motif: A compact original stag-antler stone motif branching around one upper observation window, plus one quiet star-shaped masonry keystone.
stages.architecture: Near-final vertical fortress city of four stepped large volumes, lower logistics district, middle deep weapon bay, cargo elevator recessed into left wall and upper habitation gallery.
stages.accent: grey stone, dark slate-blue armor, restrained pale gold and cyan

stages.name: 적룡 공성성채
stages.motif: A single large carved dragon shoulder on one armored buttress, with a restrained red eye-like furnace slot.
stages.architecture: Monumental vertically inhabited keep with lower weapon-service chamber, middle residential gallery, recessed cargo lift and upper command block. THREE clear big masses, no horizontal wing.
stages.accent: warm grey stone, dark iron, limited desaturated burgundy

stages.name: 사자와 세계수의 거신성
stages.motif: An enormous original stone LION FACE integrated high in the armored central arch, broad ROOT-SHAPED structural buttresses and branch-like metal power conduits embracing the recessed reactor. These motifs are actual load-bearing architecture, not flags or heraldic logos.
stages.architecture: Legendary VERTICAL mobile fortress-city: broad low logistics block with ordinary small doors, immense central reactor/weapon chamber framed by angled armored shoulders, three clearly stepped upper inhabited/command masses. Useful cargo lift, forge balcony and maintenance bridge INSIDE the width. Great dimensional depth and human-scale openings; no giant palace front door, no thin spire. Simplify into large powerful masses that read at game resolution.
stages.accent: warm grey stone, charcoal steel, dull bronze structural plates, restricted pale-cyan core and warm amber windows
